--查出一次压测所有压测指标值re1
select --分析基准日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate, --分析开始日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate, --分析结束日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate, --压测执行时间 DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime, --测试id t.test_id as testId, --测试名称 sst.test_name as testName, --组合id t.object_id as portfolioId, --组合名称 so.object_name as portfolioName, --资产id t.object_id as assetId, --资产名称 so.object_name as assetName, --产品指标 t1.value as openAmount, t2.value as currentPrice, t21.value as marketCap, t22.value as allAssetsRate, t23.value as netAssetsRate, --承压指标 t3.value as scenePrice, t4.value as priceChange, t5.value as sceneMarVal, t6.value as allAssetsRate2, t7.value as netAssetsRate2, t8.value as proAndLosRat, t9.value as amountOfDam from STT_TEST_OBJ t left join STT_OBJECT so on so.object_id=t.object_id left join STT_STRESS_TEST sst on t.test_id=sst.test_id left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t1 on t.test_id=t1.test_id and t.object_id=t1.object_id and t1.ind_id='10016' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t2 on t.test_id=t2.test_id and t.object_id=t2.object_id and t2.ind_id='10017' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t21 on t.test_id=t21.test_id and t.object_id=t21.object_id and t21.ind_id='10018' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t22 on t.test_id=t22.test_id and t.object_id=t22.object_id and t22.ind_id='10019' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t23 on t.test_id=t23.test_id and t.object_id=t23.object_id and t23.ind_id='10020' --情景价格 left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t3 on t.test_id=t3.test_id and t.object_id=t3.object_id and t3.ind_id='10021' --价格变动 left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t4 on t.test_id=t4.test_id and t.object_id=t4.object_id and t4.ind_id='10022' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t5 on t.test_id=t5.test_id and t.object_id=t5.object_id and t5.ind_id='10023' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t6 on t.test_id=t6.test_id and t.object_id=t6.object_id and t6.ind_id='10024' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t7 on t.test_id=t7.test_id and t.object_id=t7.object_id and t7.ind_id='10025' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t8 on t.test_id=t8.test_id and t.object_id=t8.object_id and t8.ind_id='10026' left join ( select * from STT_STRESS_INDDATA t where t.test_id=#{testId} ) t9 on t.test_id=t9.test_id and t.object_id=t9.object_id and t9.ind_id='10027'

SELECT * FROM ( --汇总组合 SELECT max(baseDate) as baseDate, max(testStartDate) as testStartDate, max(testEndDate) as testEndDate, max(startTime) as startTime, testId, testName, '1' portfolioId, '汇总' portfolioName, '' as fPortfolioId, '02' as hasChildren, '1' as assetId, '' as assetName, FORMAT(sum(openAmount)) as openAmount, FORMAT(sum(currentPrice)) as currentPrice, FORMAT(sum(marketCap)) as marketCap, FORMAT(sum(allAssetsRate)) as allAssetsRate, FORMAT(sum(netAssetsRate)) as netAssetsRate, FORMAT(sum(scenePrice)) as scenePrice, FORMAT(sum(priceChange)) as priceChange, FORMAT(sum(sceneMarVal)) as sceneMarVal, FORMAT(sum(allAssetsRate2)) as allAssetsRate2, FORMAT(sum(netAssetsRate2)) as netAssetsRate2, FORMAT(sum(proAndLosRat)) as proAndLosRat, FORMAT(sum(amountOfDam)) as amountOfDam FROM (
where sst.exe_status='01' and t.test_id=#{testId} ) GROUP BY testId,testName UNION ALL SELECT baseDate, testStartDate, testEndDate, startTime, testId, testName, portfolioId, portfolioName, '1' as fPortfolioId, '01' as hasChildren, assetId, assetName, openAmount, currentPrice, marketCap, allAssetsRate, netAssetsRate, scenePrice, priceChange, sceneMarVal, allAssetsRate2, netAssetsRate2, proAndLosRat, amountOfDam FROM (
where sst.exe_status='01' and t.test_id=#{testId} ) )A
AND CASE A.fPortfolioId WHEN NULL THEN 'root' ELSE (CASE A.fPortfolioId WHEN ' ' THEN 'root' ELSE A.fPortfolioId END) END = #{parentId}
ORDER BY A.ASSETID asc

SELECT * FROM ( --汇总
SELECT --分析基准日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate, --分析开始日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate, --分析结束日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate, --压测执行时间 DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime, --测试id sst.test_id as testId, --测试名称 sst.test_name as testName, -- '' portfolioId, '汇总' portfolioName, '' as fPortfolioId, '02' as hasChildren, '' as assetId, '1' as idTree, '' as assetName, -- '' type8, '' type9, '' type10, '' type11, '' type12, '' as assetType2, --产品指标 t1.value as openAmount, null as currentPrice, t3.value as marketCap, null as allAssetsRate, null as netAssetsRate, --承压指标 null as scenePrice, null as priceChange, t8.value as sceneMarVal, null as allAssetsRate2, null as netAssetsRate2, 100*t12.value/(CASE t3.value WHEN 0 THEN null ELSE t3.value END) as proAndLosRat, t12.value as amountOfDam FROM STT_STRESS_TEST sst left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t1 on sst.test_id = t1.test_id and t1.ind_id='10016' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t2 on sst.test_id = t2.test_id and t2.ind_id='10017' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t3 on sst.test_id = t3.test_id and t3.ind_id='10018' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t4 on sst.test_id = t4.test_id and t4.ind_id='10019' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t5 on sst.test_id = t5.test_id and t5.ind_id='10020' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t6 on sst.test_id = t6.test_id and t6.ind_id='10021' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t7 on sst.test_id = t7.test_id and t7.ind_id='10022' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t8 on sst.test_id = t8.test_id and t8.ind_id='10023' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t9 on sst.test_id = t9.test_id and t9.ind_id='10024' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t10 on sst.test_id = t10.test_id and t10.ind_id='10025' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t11 on sst.test_id = t11.test_id and t11.ind_id='10026' left join ( SELECT TEST_ID, IND_ID, sum(VALUE) value FROM STT_STRESS_INDDATA WHERE test_id=#{testId} GROUP BY TEST_ID,IND_ID ) t12 on sst.test_id = t12.test_id and t12.ind_id='10027' where sst.exe_status='01' and sst.test_id=#{testId}
union all
--资产类型，资产二级类型 select max(baseDate) as baseDate, max(testStartDate) as testStartDate, max(testEndDate) as testEndDate, max(startTime) as startTime, '' as testId, '' as testName, -- portfolioId, portfolioName, '1' as fPortfolioId, '02' as hasChildren, '' as assetId, portfolioId as idTree, '' as assetName, max(type8) type8, --type9, '' as type9, max(type10) type10, max(type11) type11, max(type12) type12, '' as assetType2, --产品指标 sum(case indId when '10016' then value else '' end) openAmount, null currentPrice, sum(case indId when '10018' then value else '' end) marketCap, null allAssetsRate, null netAssetsRate, --承压指标 null scenePrice, null priceChange, sum(case indId when '10023' then value else '' end) sceneMarVal, null allAssetsRate2, null netAssetsRate2, 100*sum(case indId when '10027' then value else '' end)/(CASE sum(case indId when '10018' then value else '' end) WHEN 0 THEN null ELSE sum(case indId when '10018' then value else ''end ) END) proAndLosRat, sum(case indId when '10027' then value else '' end) amountOfDam
from (select --分析基准日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate, --分析开始日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate, --分析结束日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate, --压测执行时间 DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime, --测试id sst.test_id as testId, --测试名称 sst.test_name as testName, --指标id ssi.IND_ID as indId, ssi.value, --组合id ssi.OBJECT_ID as portfolioId, --组合名称 so.object_name as portfolioName, --资产id ssi.ELEMENT_ID as assetId, --资产名称 se.OBJECT_NAME as assetName, --行内一级 sea1.PARAM_VALUE type8, --行内二级 sea2.PARAM_VALUE type9, --行内三级 sea3.PARAM_VALUE type10, --行内四级 sea4.PARAM_VALUE type11, --行内五级 sea5.PARAM_VALUE type12 from STT_STRESS_INDDATA ssi left join STT_STRESS_TEST sst on ssi.TEST_ID = sst.TEST_ID left join stt_object so on ssi.OBJECT_ID = so.OBJECT_ID left join STT_ELEMENT se on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = se.ELEMENT_ID left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea1 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea1.ELEMENT_ID and sea1.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_8' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea2 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea2.ELEMENT_ID and sea2.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_9' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea3 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea3.ELEMENT_ID and sea3.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_10' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea4 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea4.ELEMENT_ID and sea4.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_11' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea5 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea5.ELEMENT_ID and sea5.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_12' where sst.TEST_ID=#{testId} ) group by portfolioId,portfolioName
union all --明细资产 select max(baseDate) as baseDate, max(testStartDate) as testStartDate, max(testEndDate) as testEndDate, max(startTime) as startTime, '' as testId, '' as testName, -- '' portfolioId, '' portfolioName, portfolioId as fPortfolioId, '01' as hasChildren, assetId, assetId as idTree, assetName, --max(type8) type8, '' as type8, max(type9) type9, max(type10) type10, max(type11) type11, max(type12) type12, case max(type9) when '02' then max(type11) when '03' then max(type11) else max(type10) end as assetType2, --产品指标 round(sum(case indId when '10016' then value else '' end),2) openAmount, round(sum(case indId when '10017' then value else '' end),2) currentPrice, round(sum(case indId when '10018' then value else '' end),2) marketCap, round(sum(case indId when '10019' then value else '' end),4) allAssetsRate, round(sum(case indId when '10020' then value else '' end),4) netAssetsRate, --承压指标 round(sum(case indId when '10021' then value else '' end),2) scenePrice, round(sum(case indId when '10022' then value else '' end),2) priceChange, round(sum(case indId when '10023' then value else '' end),2) sceneMarVal, round(sum(case indId when '10024' then value else '' end),4) allAssetsRate2, round(sum(case indId when '10025' then value else '' end),4) netAssetsRate2, round(sum(case indId when '10026' then value else '' end),4) proAndLosRat, round(sum(case indId when '10027' then value else '' end),2) amountOfDam from (select --分析基准日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.BASE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as baseDate, --分析开始日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testStartDate, --分析结束日期 DATE_FORMAT(sst.ANALYSIS_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as testEndDate, --压测执行时间 DATE_FORMAT(sst.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') as startTime, --测试id sst.test_id as testId, --测试名称 sst.test_name as testName, --指标id ssi.IND_ID as indId, ssi.value, --组合id ssi.OBJECT_ID as portfolioId, --组合名称 so.object_name as portfolioName, --资产id ifnull(se.source_id,ssi.ELEMENT_ID) as assetId, --资产名称 se.OBJECT_NAME as assetName, --行内一级 sea1.PARAM_VALUE type8, --行内二级 sea2.PARAM_VALUE type9, --行内三级 sea3.PARAM_VALUE type10, --行内四级 sea4.PARAM_VALUE type11, --行内五级 sea5.PARAM_VALUE type12 from STT_STRESS_INDDATA ssi left join STT_STRESS_TEST sst on ssi.TEST_ID = sst.TEST_ID left join stt_object so on ssi.OBJECT_ID = so.OBJECT_ID left join STT_ELEMENT se on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = se.ELEMENT_ID left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea1 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea1.ELEMENT_ID and sea1.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_8' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea2 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea2.ELEMENT_ID and sea2.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_9' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea3 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea3.ELEMENT_ID and sea3.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_10' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea4 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea4.ELEMENT_ID and sea4.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_11' left join STT_ELEMENT_ATTR sea5 on ssi.ELEMENT_ID = sea5.ELEMENT_ID and sea5.PARAM_CODE='TYPE_12' where sst.TEST_ID=#{testId} ) group by portfolioId,assetId,assetName )A --按树结构查出数据，导出用 START WITH A.idtree='1' CONNECT BY PRIOR A.idTree = A.fPortfolioId
AND CASE A.fPortfolioId WHEN NULL THEN 'root' ELSE (CASE A.fPortfolioId WHEN ' 'THEN 'root' ELSE A.fPortfolioId END ) END = #{parentId}
order by A.TYPE8,TYPE9,ASSETID
